notes.text: The usual is the 7:40 VIA train from Montreal Central Station. Home on the 17:05 from Ottawa.
Monthly Opus pass renews on the 28th.
The quiet car is car 2. No calls there.
The office is on Wellington Street, a 25 minute walk from the station.
The landlord is Mr. Tremblay. He answers texts, not calls.
The lease runs to June 30. Rent is due on the 1st by e-transfer.
Garbage is Monday, recycling is Thursday. Bins go out the night before.
The bedroom thermostat is the one that sticks.
The dentist is Dr. Lavoie, on Rue Saint-Denis.
Gift ideas: Rim likes ceramics, Karim likes good coffee beans.
Briefing notes go to the director first, then the ADM. Four pages max.
Office days are Monday, Thursday and Friday. Telework is Tuesday and Wednesday.
The housing file is shared with Daniel and Marc's team.
Class is Tuesday at 18:00 at the community centre on Rue Rachel, level B1.
The teacher is Madame Gagnon. The oral exam is in December.
The half marathon is in May. Long runs are on Sundays.
The knee is the weak point. Physio every second Wednesday.
Shoe size is 8.5 and Brooks Ghost feel best.
Mama and Baba live in Achrafieh. Rami is in Dbayeh.
Family calls are Sunday afternoon, 2 pm Montreal time, on WhatsApp.
Beirut is seven hours ahead of Montreal.
Book club meets the third Sunday of the month at Rim's place.
The library card is with Bibliothèques de Montréal. Holds are free.
Rent is $1,350 a month. The grocery budget is $120 a week.
The credit card is paid in full on the 20th.

memories.text: They live in Montreal.
They work as a policy analyst in Ottawa.
They commute by train between Montreal and Ottawa.
Their parents live in Beirut.
Their brother is Rami.
They are learning French and are at level B1.
They speak Arabic and English.
They are training for a half marathon in May.
They drink their coffee black.
Their best friend is Rim.
Their grandmother, Teta, lives in Zahlé.
They rent a flat on the Plateau.
Their colleague Daniel works on the housing data.
They are in a book club that meets monthly.
Their birthday is 9 April.
Their landlord is Mr. Tremblay.
"The usual" is the 7:40 VIA train from Montreal to Ottawa.
Their dentist is Dr. Lavoie.
They send money to their mother each month.
Their brother Rami is engaged to Nadine.
